title: A headless runner cannot edit the files of an item that touches guard paths, and sprint start does not say so: the run stalls twice and no-progress stops it
goal: bl_plan start (and the autopilot's start) names, for each item of the sprint whose touches are guard-class (bl_authority PATHS agents-rule or push, the files headless_guard denies a headless Edit/Write of), that a headless runner cannot edit them, and the manager does not start such a sprint headless: it reports the sprint as operator-present only (a scan of the live backlog finds about 60 open items touching guarded paths); found by the SP-zihqagoi review (a contradiction between BG-6ndiy7xf, BG-6roybevi and BG-4irnmsbs: a sprint of guarded items would be restarted until no-progress stops it)

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/bl_plan.py',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if 'headless' in t and 'guard' in t else 1)

repro_reason: the stall shows only over a started sprint with guard-class items and several runner restarts; the repro reads bl_plan for any start-time guard notice until the item's own test (headless_start_guarded_items) exists
